info.title: unprotect
info.description: Companion tool to protect — decrypts files that protect encrypted, using the same native OS key-storage primitives.

options.name: --in-place
options.description: Replace FILE atomically via temp + rename. Mutually exclusive with --output.

options.name: --rm
options.description: Delete source FILE after successful round-trip verification.

options.name: --keep
options.description: Retain source FILE (explicit default; accepted for symmetry with --rm).

options.name: --no-verify
options.description: Skip the post-encrypt round-trip integrity check (encrypt path only). Faster, less safe.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing destination file. Without this flag, the tool refuses to clobber existing data. Symlink-safe: the destination is unlinked before exclusive create, so an attacker-planted symlink cannot redirect the write.

options.name: --output
options.description: Explicit output path. Default: FILE with .prot stripped for file input, stdout for stdin.

options.name: --scope
options.description: Key-derivation scope. 'user' (default) — key bound to current OS user, decryptable only by that user on that machine. 'machine' — key bound to machine credential, decryptable by any user on that machine (Windows needs DPAPI LocalMachine access; macOS needs sudo for System Keychain; Linux: unsupported — tool exits with usage error).

options.name: --describe
options.description: Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

options.name: --color
options.description: Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never
